Piper Diagram Coordinates

Source: R/geochemistry.R
piper_data.Rd

Creates Piper-diagram coordinate data from major-ion chemistry.

piper_data(df, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
piper_data(df, location, analyte, result, unit, date, ...)

# S3 method for class 'env_schema'
piper_data(
  df,
  analyte_matching = c("strict", "exact", "normalized"),
  x_cation = "Calcium, dissolved",
  y_cation = "Magnesium, dissolved",
  z_cation = c("Sodium, dissolved", "Potassium, dissolved"),
  x_anion = c("Chloride, total", "Fluoride, total"),
  y_anion = "Alkalinity, total (lab)",
  z_anion = "Sulfate, total",
  scale_analyte = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A data frame or `env_schema` object.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

location

Location identifier column.

analyte

Analyte column.

result

Analytical result column.

unit

Reporting unit column.

date

Sample date column.

analyte_matching

Analyte matching strategy used to resolve analyte names. One of `"exact"`, `"strict"`, or `"normalized"`.

x_cation

Character vector identifying analytes representing calcium.

y_cation

Character vector identifying analytes representing magnesium.

z_cation

Character vector identifying analytes representing sodium and potassium.

x_anion

Character vector identifying analytes representing chloride and fluoride.

y_anion

Character vector identifying analytes representing alkalinity.

z_anion

Character vector identifying analytes representing sulfate.

scale_analyte

Optional analyte used to scale point size.

Value

A data frame containing Piper plotting coordinates.

Details

`piper_data()` is an S3 generic that supports both raw data frames and `env_schema` objects.

Major-ion concentrations are converted to milliequivalents per liter (meq/L), normalized to ionic percentages, and transformed into Piper plotting coordinates.

Output Variables

  • `cation_x`

  • `cation_y`

  • `anion_x`

  • `anion_y`

  • `diamond_x`

  • `diamond_y`

One row is returned for each unique location and sample-date combination.

Examples

data(gw)

piper_data(gw)
